_comment: Same runner set-up as packages/core: the command runner because @stryker-mutator/vitest-runner does not activate mutants under Vitest 5, and a deliberately missing tsconfigFile because TypeScript 7 has no JavaScript API for Stryker to read it with. run.e2e.test.ts links the workspace and runs tsc and vitest, so it stays out of the per-mutant runs.
